[SWS_CM_10288] Transport protocol for sending of a SOME/IP event message
⌈
The SOME/IP event message shall be transmitted using UDP if the threshold de-
fined by the multicastThreshold attribute of the SomeipProvidedEventGroup
that is aggregated by the ProvidedSomeipServiceInstance in the role event-
Group in the Manifest has been reached (see [PRS_SOMEIPSD_00134]).
The
SOME/IP event message shall be transmitted using the transport protocol defined by the attribute SomeipServiceInterfaceDeployment.eventDeployment.trans-
portProtocol in the Manifest if this threshold has not been reached (see [PRS_-
SOMEIPSD_00802]).
⌋
